Course: Database Management Systems (B.Tech CSE Sem 4)
Unit 1: Introduction, file systems vs DBMS, ER model, network & hierarchical models.
Unit 2: Relational model, relational algebra, tuple calculus.
Unit 3: SQL — DDL, DML, joins, sub-queries, views.

Unit 5: Transactions, ACID, concurrency control, recovery.
Lab: Oracle SQL*Plus exercises.
